items.title: John E. Wood Interview, 1986-06-26
items.q: called Mr. Jelly Roll. Alan Lomax did it.

ctx.x: Well, did you hear a lot of jazz in those places, like Virginia and Indiana?

No, no, no, Richard. No? No? I didn't hear much jazz in any of those places. I guess before I came here as a graduate student, I had, as a high school student, I had enjoyed listening to a great variety of music. I had particularly enjoyed some black folk blues people, Lead Belly. I had a great collection of Lead Belly records when I was a high school student. And some Josh White records that I played a lot, Blind Lemon Jefferson records. And I had read a book or two. I can't really even tell you. It was a book…
